name: barmkin-mod
description: Claude Code mods security layer: secret redaction, untrusted-content taint with a Rule-of-Two egress gate, skill inline-shell mediation guard, MCP tool-poisoning guard, skill-content screen, agent-to-agent firewall, SAST findings UI, and a Jev System One classifier gateway with an explanation surface.

jev_base_url.title: Jev System One base URL
jev_base_url.description: System One wire-format endpoint (OpenRouter or Vercel AI Gateway style, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api). The mod POSTs to {base_url}/v1/systemone. Never barmkin's internal gateway. Leave empty to run with the classifier disabled (taint marking falls back to pattern heuristics only).

jev_model.title: Jev model id
jev_model.description: Pinned Jev model spelling for your provider, e.g. jev-1.13.0 (TypeSafe direct) or typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 (OpenRouter). Must match the jev-1.13 pattern.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: Bearer credential for the System One endpoint. Stored in secure credential storage, never written to settings.json or logged.

mcp_server_allowlist.title: Allowed MCP server names
mcp_server_allowlist.description: Comma-separated MCP server names allowed to run tools (parsed from mcp__<server>__<tool>). Leave empty to allow all servers (audit-only, no enforcement).

sast_hold_on_high_severity.title: Hold on high-severity SAST findings
sast_hold_on_high_severity.description: When a semgrep ERROR-severity finding appears after an edit, ask the user to acknowledge it before the turn continues. When off, findings are advisory only (shown inline and fed to Claude as context).

sdk_prompts_clear_taint.title: Let SDK prompts clear the taint
sdk_prompts_clear_taint.description: By default only a prompt a person sent (terminal composer or Remote Control bridge) clears the untrusted-content taint and the sensitive-access flag. Turn this on for a headless lane (claude -p, the Agent SDK), where every prompt has the sdk origin and a person is not at a terminal.

sast_semgrep_path.title: semgrep binary path
sast_semgrep_path.description: Absolute path to the semgrep binary, for when it isn't resolvable by bare name on the Claude Code process's PATH (e.g. a pipx/`pip install --user` binary under ~/.local/bin). Leave empty to auto-probe common install locations before falling back to bare `semgrep`.
